items: 【Patent Design】Experience the difference with our uniquely designed furniture gliders, protected by patent

【Safe and Reliable Design】New furniture movers with wheels has an anti-slip groove design and with anti-slip pads that prevent the furniture from sliding off the floor during moving, ensuring the safety of the furniture and people

【High-Quality Furniture Slider】New Upgrade heavy duty furniture slider with grooves made of thickened high-quality plastic with reinforced base, not easy to deform.Widened 360-Degree silent rubber wheels can move flexibly without hurting the floor, the extendable carbon steel pry bar can save your strength and lift objects easily

【Furniture Lift Mover Tool Set】Our furniture dolly set includes 4 x furniture sliders with 360° rotation rubber wheels each, 1 x pry bar and 4 anti-slip pads. Lightweight and easy to use. This furniture moving tool set is designed to make your moving experience easier and more efficient

【Easy to Use】The furniture dolly lifter tool provides leverage to lift your heavy furniture or home appliances, and then slide the four rollers underneath each corner. Remove the pry bar to move the object. You can now roll your appliance around with little effort. This furniture lift mover can support up 750 lbs

【Widely Applicable】With this furniture mover slider, you can easily move all kinds of furnitures and appliances,such as beds, sofas, tables, cabinets, refrigerators, and washing machines. It is also suitable for use on hardwood floors, tile floors and laminate flooring
